title: PIN AND EAT THIS HUD. start full gray static. seep. sieve granules + liquid from metal + gas.

this_shot.where: hud.primals.eco — Human Universe Display. black dump. everything at once.
this_shot.circled_left: inner plane. compass + glass. a metal ring with almost no granule. flux did not stick.
this_shot.circled_right: sparse orbit. a few colored dots in a lot of black. tempo thin.
this_shot.green_bar: liquid. the only place you can already see flow (nestgate / DS diffusion line).
this_shot.why_it_fails: black is not the basin. black hides the stick. everything painted NOW, so you cannot tell what arrived and what was already furniture.

do_not_reinvent.pool: /data/reflecting-pool.json — HUD starts GREY. puddle. drips. already the law. never the paint.
do_not_reinvent.null: /data/hud-null-of-the-image.json — keep the pale. if we stock the song nothing can appear.
do_not_reinvent.sieve: /data/klein-sieve.json — mesh already named. entropy vs chaos. do not build a fifth stick.
do_not_reinvent.states: /data/periodic-table.json — solid / glass / liquid / gas / plasma. the HOW.

why_we_couldnt.hose: the HUD is a hose. twenty scripts dump on black. a basin RECEIVES.
why_we_couldnt.gold: this glass is Caddy. new paint 404s until the morning vesicle. copper can show. do not stare at gold for the seep.
why_we_couldnt.not: we cannot eat the screenshot as a spy on the viewer. we eat the DUMP as a meal — pin it, then start over gray.

eat.yes: pin THIS. the dump is food. chew it. do not keep serving the whole plate at t=0.
eat.meal: nav-ring, cartesian axes, inner-plane compass, voxel numbers, chipmunk strip, green diffusion bar, two empty ovals.
eat.after: empty the plate. grey static. then seep.

gray_static.yes: full gray. not black (null of light already taken). not white (null of sound). GREY. the average. the sieve mesh you can still see.
gray_static.static: the grain IS the mesh. L_p holes. what does not pass stays a clump you can point at.

seep.yes: slow. so tempo and flux show WHERE THEY STICK.
order: gas — labels, mute, atmosphere. fills. if it sticks it is weather.
liquid — green bar, water wheel dip, k˜1.9 flow.
metal — axes, compass, rings. the wheel iron. metallic pile.
granule — dots that stay. crystal / sand. the stick you circled.
seep.stick: a clump that arrives early and does not move = granule. a smear that keeps moving = liquid. a ring that never fills = metal hungry. gray that never thins = no flux. THAT is the read.

sieve.like: ooze through a sieve. separate granules and liquid from metal and gas.
sieve.pass: liquid + some gas through the holes.
sieve.hold: metal frame. granules that will not fit.
sieve.already: klein-sieve. this is the RENDER of that mesh. not a new organ.

pull: eat the dump. paint gray static. seep gas ? liquid ? metal ? granule. the two ovals are already the diagnosis: metal without food. look at copper for the seep. gold waits for morning.
